# ClawImaging

> ClawImaging is a reproducibility-first computational imaging skill library.
> It preserves the strongest architectural ideas from ClawBio—modular skills,
> orchestration, local-first execution, and artifact bundles—and retargets them
> to CT, MRI, coherent imaging, and benchmark-driven open research software.

- `README.md` — project overview and quickstart

## Skills

- `ct-recon` — CT / tomography reconstruction
- `mri-recon` — raw k-space MRI reconstruction
- `phase-retrieve` — phase retrieval / coherent imaging
- `benchmark-run` — run declared benchmark tracks
- `repro-export` — archive-ready reproducibility export
- `paper-figure` — regenerate manuscript figures and tables

## Python package

- `src/clawimaging/cli.py` — CLI entry point
- `src/clawimaging/registry.py` — skill catalog loading
- `src/clawimaging/orchestrator.py` — routing logic
- `src/clawimaging/specs.py` — experiment and benchmark data models
- `src/clawimaging/artifacts.py` — reproducibility bundle creation
- `src/clawimaging/scaffold_skill.py` — demo skill helper

## Commands

```bash
python scripts/generate_catalog.py
python -m pytest
python -m src.clawimaging.cli list
python skills/ct-recon/ct_recon.py --demo --output /tmp/clawimaging-ct-demo
python skills/mri-recon/mri_recon.py --demo --output /tmp/clawimaging-mri-demo
```

## Agent rule of thumb

Prefer explicit experiment specs, explicit provenance, and explicit artifact bundles.
